verdicts.reason: A turns the vertical stack into a sensible left-to-right banner with even gaps around the divider. However, the two PRAY words are different sizes, so the parallel structure is lost, and the rose, the original's main image, shrinks to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the right edge. B has the same mismatched PRAY sizes and tiny rose, and its first PRAY sits right against the divider line, which makes the spacing uneven and the layout look cramped.
